summary: Regional telecom/ISP (ADSL1/2 broadband + fixed-line + VoIP bundles, from ~2005); retail site alive to 2011, hosting disabled by 2012, dead c. 2011 (MATTSON CONSULTING PTY LTD & WICKS INDUSTRIES PTY LTD (partnership), ABN 63 832 712 870).

events.details: Telecommunications provider; ADSL1/ADSL2 broadband, fixed-line telephone and VoIP; earliest Wayback capture Aug 2006.

Full retail homepage still live Feb 2011; by Feb 2012 the site returned an InterWorx 'Site Disabled' (hosting suspended) page, parked thereafter. Real ISP site live Feb 2011, spam blog from Apr 2011 and suspended by Feb 2012 - the ISP died in 2011, confirming the proposal.
